values.note: Single site $20 a night, premium single (no hookups) $24, single with electric $25, single with full hookups $39; double site $40. Day use $5 per vehicle. recreation.gov's 2026 rate table agrees ($20 / $24 / $25; its $40 rows are the doubles).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/kiasutha-recreation-area ('Single Site: $20 per night ... Single Site with electric hook-up: $25 per night Single Site with full hook-ups: $39 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232065/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/kiasutha-recreation-area ('With electric: 12 sites With electric/water/sewage: 12 sites') + recreation.gov catalog for 232065 (electric sites list 30/50-amp; 6 reservable sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Forest Service: 96 family campsites, 6 tent and 90 RV (12 with electric, 12 with electric/water/sewer); recreation.gov says about 98 reservable. Catalog max vehicle lengths mostly 25-40 ft, a few 45; 'Some sites are back-in and some are pull-through.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/kiasutha-recreation-area ('There are 96 family campsites', 'Tent sites: 6 RV Sites: 90') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232065 ('Some sites are back-in and some are pull-through') + catalog (Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/kiasutha-recreation-area ('flush toilets', 'Drinking water is available from faucets', 'hot showers', 'trailer dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Forest Service: 'Campground is open between 04/01 - 09/04. Camping reservations are accepted 04/01 - 09/04.' recreation.gov's 2026 peak rate season ran to Sep 7.

'Reservations are accepted for some sites. First come, first served sites are also available.' Up to 6 months ahead on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777; recreation.gov closes booking 4 days before arrival, the Forest Service page says at least 3 days ahead. recreation.gov rules: 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimum on reservations. Walk-up fees paid by 2 pm.

summary: Confirmed 50-amp with water+sewer, $20 base, reservable on recreation.gov (6-month window). Changed fees high 25 -> 39 (full-hookup single site). Added 96 sites to 45 ft with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, season Apr 1 - Sep 4 (Forest Service statement), 4-day cutoff, some FCFS sites, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum on reservations. The FS page currently shows 'Site Closed' (consistent with the season ending 09/04), so no status was recorded.
